description: Reference utterances for the STT lessons. Each carries the channel and noise condition it is to be transcribed under by the deterministic stand-in in vox/stt.py. snr_db is null for clean recordings. style drives the envelope generator in vox/audio.py: normal, slow (long mid-utterance pauses), rushed.
